Starting values are examples. Set your actual SST/ART, dispatch, factoring and operating costs. Daily overhead can include insurance, ELD, trailer and truck payments. Maintenance is a reserve, not a cash bill for this trip.

PDF text and scanned PDF pages are supported, plus JPG, PNG and WebP photos. Up to 10 MB per file. Scanning reads English text and may take a minute. Compare your fuel stops.
Compare two quotes, including discounts, refundable tax and extra miles.
TFS compares regional prices net of refundable taxes. Check the latest source and enter verified quotes below. This is a comparison tool, not a live station finder or an IFTA return. Open TFS fuel guide ↗
Use USD per US gallon for both stops. Detour cost uses pump price, truck MPG, maintenance and driver pay per mile; extra time and jurisdiction tax differences are excluded. Refundable tax must be eligible and verified.
